name: switchboard_turn
description: Send the caller's utterance to the Switchboard decision service and receive the exact line to say back. Must be called for every caller turn, including greetings and one-word answers. This tool holds all conversation state, verification status and policy; nothing may be decided without it.

call_id.description: The ElevenLabs conversation id. Must be identical for every turn of the same call - it is the key the service resumes state from, and a new value restarts the call from scratch.

utterance.description: Exactly what the caller just said, transcribed. Do not clean it up, correct it, or summarise it.

asr_confidence.description: Transcription confidence between 0 and 1. Pass the real value: the service uses it to decide when the line is too poor to continue safely, and a hardcoded 1.0 disables that protection.

end_call.description: If true, end the call after speaking the reply.

ticket_id.description: Ticket reference, if one was created. Already included in reply.

approval_id.description: Approval reference, if one was raised. Already included in reply.
